namespaceHelp: Declare the namespace that identifies these ordered elements. It is required and is never inferred from a column name.
variableLength: Each retained value carries its own element count, including an empty sequence. There is no fixed shape.
policyRequired: Sequences require explicit resource limits for their retained element interpretation.
symbolHelp: Symbolic strings retain their exact text, including empty strings. Null remains distinct. No numeric order or unit meaning is inferred.
numericHelp: Every non-null element uses the same explicit representation and base. Original spelling and null positions are retained.
pageHelp: Elements are shown in retained order. Positions start at 1; the count belongs to this value.
graphUpgradeHelp: Create a new graph revision for explicitly declared sequences. Review the saved operation limits. Earlier graph revisions and retained results keep their original interpretation.
graphHelp: Choose an earlier declared sequence. These operations preserve its namespace, element interpretation and pinned source positions. They do not sort or infer an alignment.
rangeHelp: Positions start at 1. A slice count may be 0; an empty slice may begin just after the last element. Out-of-range positions are refused without clamping or wrapping.
concatenateHelp: Concatenation requires matching declared namespaces and element interpretation. Numeric units must describe the same coordinates; there is no conversion or implicit alignment.
operandInvalid: Choose the required sequence nodes from before this node.
rangeInvalid: Enter exact whole positions starting at 1 and a nonnegative whole count within supported indexing capacity.
symbolPageHelp: Strings use quoted JSON text: spaces and escapes remain explicit, and an empty string is "". JSON null is distinct. Long symbols show one quoted fragment at a time; character ranges refer to the original text.
